findings.title: find_order missing ownership check — IDOR vulnerability
findings.detail: find_order fetches order by id with no user_id ownership verification, allowing any user to read another's order.
findings.evidence: return conn.execute("SELECT id, sku, quantity, total FROM orders WHERE id = ?", (order_id,)).fetchone()
findings.remediation: Add ownership check: if owner != user_id raise PermissionError.
